name: Shallaki
actions: Traditionally used for joint pain and swelling
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; taken as standardised extract capsules or in formulations.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary

cautions.note: Talk to your doctor first if you have asthma; it may interact with asthma medicines.
If you are being treated for cancer, ask your cancer team before using it.
Little is known about medicinal amounts in pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

evidence.summary: Trials suggest boswellia may ease osteoarthritis pain and swelling, but more rigorous studies are needed.
